2. By the present application, the Applicants have sought to recall the order dated 05/10/2023 in the Interim Application No.3556 of 2023 and thus sought restoration of the said interim application, which was dismissed for non-prosecution.
3. Learned counsel for the Petitioner and Respondent No.2 state that the parties have settled the matrimonial dispute.
In the light of the said statement and in view of the reasons stated in the application, order dated 05/10/2023 in Interim application No.3556 of 2023 is recalled.
The Interim Application No.3556 of 2023 is restored.
